- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hari Raya Aidilfitri marks the end of the Islamic holy month of Ramadan and involves traditional clothing, feasting, gift-giving, and charity work.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pongal is a harvest festival celebrated by the Indian community, involving traditional dishes, home decorations, and cultural activities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pesta Nasi Kandar is a food festival celebrating local cuisine, featuring traditional dishes like nasi kandar.
